name: B10-0069/2025 (S&D) – Case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for Jean-Jacques Wondo's death sentence to be overturned. Wondo is a Belgian-Congolese security expert sentenced to death in the Democratic Republic of Congo over a failed coup he says he had nothing to do with. The Parliament also asks Congo to stop using military courts for civilians, to bring back its ban on the death penalty, and to let civil society work freely. The text is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- Congo is asked to cancel Wondo's and 36 others' death sentences.
- Congo should restore its death penalty ban and stop trying civilians in military courts.
- The EU and its member states are urged to press Congo's authorities.
